{{Top|canon=K21c portable ordnance launcher}}
The '''K21''' was a [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] shoulder-fired rocket launcher. Exceptionally powerful for its size, the launcher was more than capable of bringing down a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] in midair.
